
8. Agents
An agent is a coding assistant. Only detected agents can be configured.

Agent: claude
on: render the content's agent configuration for this agent.
off: write nothing new for it; earlier outputs stay.
A value that Fleet did not write stops setup before writes.
Press Enter to keep the shown choice.
claude [on]:

Agent: codex
on: render the content's agent configuration for this agent.
off: write nothing new for it; earlier outputs stay.
A value that Fleet did not write stops setup before writes.
Press Enter to keep the shown choice.
codex [off]:

Agent: gemini
on: render the content's agent configuration for this agent.
off: write nothing new for it; earlier outputs stay.
A value that Fleet did not write stops setup before writes.
Press Enter to keep the shown choice.
gemini [off]:
